summary: Inventory every workflow, Dockerfile, Makefile, release path + public artifact + historical version across engine and operator, and flag duplicate-publisher risk

highRisk: pacto CLI binaries + checksums.txt + GitHub Release object (.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (build+publish) AND .github/workflows/release.yml (build+publish) -> repo root (cmd/pacto) — release-unit: engine)

pacto-operator Go module + GitHub Release (release has NO binary assets) (integrations/kubernetes/.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (release job: gh release create -> git tag) -> integrations/kubernetes/ — release-unit: kubernetes integration)

pacto-controller container image (multi-arch amd64+arm64) (integrations/kubernetes/.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (docker-build matrix + docker-merge) -> integrations/kubernetes/Dockerfile — release-unit: kubernetes integration)
Operator Go module (auto-release.yml (release job: gh release create + git tag) -> integrations/kubernetes (Go submodule under go.work))

Demo OCI contract bundles (pacto-demo/*) (none in operator; samples only reference them; upstream published via `cd ../pacto-demo && make push` -> integrations/kubernetes/config/samples (consumer only) — publisher must be brought in-repo or samples repointed)

operator controller image (ghcr.io/trianalab/pacto-operator/pacto-controller) (integrations/kubernetes/.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (docker-build matrix + docker-merge + cosign) -> integrations/kubernetes release-unit)

operator Helm chart (ghcr.io/trianalab/charts/pacto-operator) (integrations/kubernetes/.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (helm job: sed version+appVersion, helm-docs, helm package/push, cosign) -> integrations/kubernetes release-unit (chart co-versioned with operator))

demo contract bundles (ghcr.io/trianalab/pacto-demo/* — 15 pkgs: payments-service, orders-service, api-gateway, frontend, auth-service, fraud-service, notification-worker, postgresql, redis, stripe-api, email-provider, platform-app-config, platform-http-policy, platform-worker-config, pacto-demo) (none (manual). Referenced by operator config/samples/demo + scenarios/01-demo-oci.yaml; also embedded OFFLINE in examples/demo WASM via genlocks (deterministic, no live pull) -> UNOWNED — decide: examples/demo or integrations/kubernetes/config/samples release-unit)
GitHub Release object (engine) (.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (job: release, `gh release create`) -> monorepo release-unit `engine` (root); tag namespace must become e.g. engine/vX)

CLI release binaries pacto_{linux,darwin,windows}_{amd64,arm64} + checksums.txt  [DUPLICATE-PUBLISHED] (.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (jobs: build+publish) AND .github/workflows/release.yml (jobs: build+publish) -> monorepo release-unit `engine`; collapse to ONE publisher (drop release.yml or make auto-release the sole path))

Container image ghcr.io/trianalab/pacto-operator/pacto-controller (integrations/kubernetes/.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (jobs: docker-build matrix -> docker-merge -> cosign sign) -> monorepo release-unit `integrations/kubernetes/controller-image`; `go list -m` for pacto version BREAKS under same-repo replace (DASHBOARD_IMAGE empties))

Helm chart oci://ghcr.io/trianalab/charts/pacto-operator (integrations/kubernetes/.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (job: helm — helm package/push + helm-docs regen + cosign sign) -> monorepo release-unit `integrations/kubernetes/chart`; chart appVersion=operator tag but controller image tag derives from engine version — same go-list breakage risk)
duplicatePublishers: [Pacto monorepo CI/CD pipelines and published-artifact inventory (engine at repo root; operator imported at integrations/kubernetes)] CLI binaries (pacto_{os}_{arch}) + checksums.txt attached to the GitHub Release — published by BOTH TrianaLab/pacto:.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (publish job) AND TrianaLab/pacto:.github/workflows/release.yml (publish job); both run softprops/action-gh-release uploading the identical asset set to the same release/coordinate. They are complementary in practice ONLY because GitHub's anti-recursion rule means token-created releases (auto-release) don't fire the `release` event that drives release.yml — if release creation ever moves to a PAT, both fire and double-upload.

[operator (integrations/kubernetes)] Bare `vX.Y.Z` git tag + GitHub Release: TrianaLab/pacto:.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (engine 'Auto release') AND TrianaLab/pacto-operator:.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (operator) — both cut bare vX.Y.Z tags/releases on merge-to-main; in the monorepo these tag namespaces collide (engine at v2.7.0 vs operator at v4.7.0) and each is the version source for its own image/chart. This is the single biggest release-unit blocker (M4/M5). No duplicate WITHIN the operator repo — auto-release.yml is the sole publisher of every operator artifact (ci.yml and security.yml build a chart/image but never push).

[operator (integrations/kubernetes)] Coupling (not a strict duplicate): engine .github/workflows/pacto.yml triggers on `workflow_run: ['Auto release']`, so the engine dashboard-bundle publish is chained to the release workflow name — brittle across the merge.

[Pacto monorepo — published pipeline/artifact inventory (M3)] pacto CLI release binaries (pacto_<os>_<arch> + checksums.txt on the GitHub Release): TrianaLab/pacto:.github/workflows/auto-release.yml (publish job) AND TrianaLab/pacto:.github/workflows/release.yml (publish job) — both attach the same assets to the same release; de-facto mutually exclusive per release only because token-created auto releases don't fire the 'release' event, but the overlap is latent and should collapse to one publisher

[pipelines-and-artifacts (Pacto monorepo migration): every workflow-published artifact across engine (repo root) + operator (integrations/kubernetes), with historical published versions verified via gh api / GHCR, plus cross-workflow duplicate-publisher gate] CLI release binaries pacto_{os}_{arch} + checksums.txt (GitHub Release assets): pacto:auto-release.yml (build+publish jobs) + pacto:release.yml (build+publish jobs) — both build the same 6-binary matrix and upload to the same engine GitHub Release via softprops/action-gh-release@v3.0.2. release.yml is dormant for automated (GITHUB_TOKEN-created) tags because GitHub suppresses the `release: published` event for token-created releases, but it double-publishes for any human/PAT-published release. This is the one clear 'exactly one canonical publisher per artifact' violation.

perArea.area: Pacto monorepo CI/CD pipelines and published-artifact inventory (engine at repo root; operator imported at integrations/kubernetes)
perArea.notes: Verified against actual files + historical published versions (git tags, `gh api .../releases`, ghcr package versions) — NOT inferred from Chart.yaml/source. Key migration themes: (1) TAG-NAMESPACE COLLISION: today each repo owns an independent `vX.Y.Z` sequence — engine module/CLI/GitHub-release at v2.x, dashboard image 2.x, contract bundle v1.6->v2.7, operator module/release v4.x, controller image 4.x, chart 3.2->4.7. In one monorepo a single bare `v*` tag stream cannot drive all of these; the co-located operator Go submodule additionally requires a path-prefixed tag (integrations/kubernetes/vX.Y.Z) per Go submodule rules. This is the central release-unit design problem for M3/M4. (2) RELEASE ORDERING / CROSS-ARTIFACT DEPS: the operator controller image bakes build-arg DASHBOARD_IMAGE=pacto-dashboard:{engine version resolved via `go list -m github.com/trianalab/pacto/v2`}, and the chart appVersion pins the controller image — so engine dashboard image + engine module must publish before the operator builds. go.work already dropped the `replace ../pacto`, changing how that engine version resolves in-monorepo. (3) MODULE-PATH BREAK: operator published as github.com/trianalab/pacto-operator historically but is rebased to github.com/trianalab/pacto/integrations/kubernetes in the monorepo — breaks existing importers unless a redirect/retraction is planned. (4) SIGNING GAPS: all 3 container images + the Helm chart are cosign-signed, but CLI binaries have only sha256 checksums (no cosign/SBOM/provenance) and the contract bundle carries an in-bundle SPDX SBOM yet the OCI artifact is not cosign-signed; no SLSA provenance anywhere. (5) EXTERNAL DEPS out of monorepo scope but load-bearing: trianalab/pacto-actions@v1 (bundle validate/push) and TrianaLab/pacto-plugins releases (openapi-infer, schema-infer plugins downloaded at CI time). (6) Both repos duplicate near-identical auto-release.yml / ci.yml / security.yml / pr-title / dependabot-auto-merge / composite .github/actions/ci — strong candidates for consolidation in M5. (7) GitHub Pages is one-site-per-repo: engine docs.yml owns pacto.run; operator has no docs site today, so integrated MkDocs (M6) must fold operator docs into the single engine Pages deploy. No .goreleaser or root package.json exists (frontend package.json lives under pkg/dashboard/frontend, built into committed pkg/dashboard/ui via the ui-rebuild pull_request+workflow_run pair — internal, produces no published artifact). Excluded pacto-demo/* ghcr packages (separate demo repo, not built by this monorepo).

Version-source hazard: operator auto-release computes next version via `git tag --list 'v*'` (global match). In the monorepo this reads ENGINE tags too, so the operator would compute a wrong next version unless tags are path-prefixed. Go submodule versioning REQUIRES `integrations/kubernetes/vX.Y.Z` tags for `go get` to resolve the module at github.com/trianalab/pacto/integrations/kubernetes; auto-release currently produces bare `vX.Y.Z`. This, plus the module-path rewrite (github.com/trianalab/pacto-operator → .../pacto/integrations/kubernetes), is why the Go-module and image/chart rows are the highest risk.

Chart.yaml (version 0.1.0, appVersion 0.1.0) is a stale placeholder — real versions are sed-injected from the release tag at publish time; do not treat committed Chart.yaml as the version source. README is regenerated by helm-docs during release; CI (ci-chart) enforces helm-docs + api-docs drift.

Cross-repo build dependency to preserve: the operator image bakes DASHBOARD_IMAGE=ghcr.io/trianalab/pacto-dashboard:<pacto_version>, where pacto_version = `go list -m github.com/trianalab/pacto/v2` from go.mod (note the /v2 suffix; querying the bare path returns empty and bakes an untagged dashboard image). The pacto-dashboard image itself is engine-published (separate org package pacto-dashboard), not an operator artifact. RELEASING.md documents the engine-first, replace-drop (`make pacto-remote`) procedure — in the monorepo the `replace ../pacto` is superseded by go.work, so that step needs rework.

Artifact Hub: preserve repositoryID 4d7aef48-84d5-447f-bd73-8590a6801d0e and the artifacthub.io coordinate on migration or AH re-verification/ownership breaks (owner edudiazasencio). Supply-chain gaps to close at consolidation: no SBOM and no SLSA provenance/attestation for operator image or chart (only legacy cosign .sig). Security supply-chain note in security.yml: trivy-action was pinned to a raw binary after a March 2026 compromise — keep first-party/pinned installs when unifying CI. Demo OCI bundles are an external dependency (TrianaLab/pacto-demo) referenced by config/samples with :latest tags — either fold the publisher into the monorepo or repoint samples for reproducible demos.

TWO INDEPENDENT VERSION LINES that must stay decoupled post-merge: engine=v2.7.0 (module github.com/trianalab/pacto/v2), operator=v4.7.0 (module github.com/trianalab/pacto/integrations/kubernetes, no version suffix). Dashboard image + contract bundle + WASM demo track the ENGINE tag; operator image + chart + appVersion + Artifact Hub track the OPERATOR tag.

CRITICAL TAG-NAMESPACE GAP: `git -C /private/tmp/pacto-monorepo tag` contains ONLY the engine line (v0.34.1 -> v2.7.0). The operator's tags (v1.0.2 -> v4.7.0) were NOT imported, and there are NO nested-module tags (integrations/kubernetes/vX or api/vX). Both repos historically used bare `vX.Y.Z`; in one monorepo the bare namespace can belong to only ONE module. Root/engine keeps bare `vX.Y.Z`; the operator, as a nested Go module, needs path-prefixed tags `integrations/kubernetes/vX.Y.Z` (currently zero exist), and its next release must not regress below the existing v4.7.0 history that lives only in the old repo. Both auto-release.yml files compute the next version from `git tag --list 'v*'` — in the monorepo that reads the ENGINE line, so the operator workflow would mis-bump off v2.7.0 unless retargeted to a prefixed tag filter. This is the top migration blocker; M4 (Changesets) should own per-release-unit versioning.

Both repos' auto-release.yml are near-identical (bump-from-PR-title, gh release create with GITHUB_TOKEN). The token-created release does NOT fire `release` events (anti-recursion) — engine relies on this and instead chains via workflow_run(Auto release) for pacto.yml (contract bundle) and docs.yml (demo); preserve that chaining or move to explicit needs: in a unified pipeline.

TAG-PREFIX INCONSISTENCY across engine artifacts: dashboard image tag is `2.7.0` (tag#v, no v) but the contract bundle tag is `v2.7.0` (with v). Normalize in the consolidated pipeline.

SIGNING is inconsistent: operator controller image + chart use cosign LEGACY format (--new-bundle-format=false, emits sha256-<digest>.sig that Artifact Hub indexes); dashboard image uses cosign DEFAULT/new-bundle OCI 1.1 referrers (no .sig tag). Contract bundle is NOT cosign-signed but ships an SBOM as bundle content. CLI binaries have sha256 checksums only. No SLSA provenance anywhere.

DEMO OCI is unmanaged: ghcr.io/trianalab/pacto-demo/* (15 packages) has NO publishing workflow, no git-tag version source, and was seeded manually. The examples/demo WASM build embeds OFFLINE copies (genlocks, deterministic) of these same coordinates, so the live registry packages and the shipped demo can silently drift. Assign an owner + a reproducible publisher (or drop the live packages if the offline embed is authoritative).

EXTERNAL dependencies the pipelines rely on: trianalab/pacto-actions@v1 (contract setup/push in pacto.yml) and TrianaLab/pacto-plugins latest release (pacto-plugin-schema-infer, pacto-plugin-openapi-infer downloaded at CI time for bundle gen). Also scripts/get-pacto.sh is a public install script (served from repo/docs) that downloads the release binaries — not itself a versioned artifact but a public consumer of the CLI release assets; keep its URLs stable across the move.

Artifact Hub identity (repositoryID 4d7aef48-84d5-447f-bd73-8590a6801d0e, owner edudiazasencio) is bound in integrations/kubernetes/artifacthub-repo.yml and re-pushed every operator release; it must carry over byte-identical or the existing AH listing breaks.

perArea.area: pipelines-and-artifacts (Pacto monorepo migration): every workflow-published artifact across engine (repo root) + operator (integrations/kubernetes), with historical published versions verified via gh api / GHCR, plus cross-workflow duplicate-publisher gate
perArea.notes:
HISTORICAL versions are from live gh api / GHCR, not source: engine latest v2.7.0 (assets verified = 6 binaries + checksums.txt); operator latest v4.7.0 (0 assets — notes-only). Committed Chart.yaml (0.1.0) is a placeholder overwritten by sed at release time — do NOT infer versions from it.

TAG-NAMESPACE COLLISION (top monorepo risk): both repos' auto-release.yml derive the next version from `git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname`. In this merged checkout `git tag` already shows a blended line (engine v0.x/v1.x/v2.7.0 AND operator lines), and operator ships v4.x while engine ships v2.x. A single tag namespace makes 'latest v* tag' cross-contaminate the two release lines — per-release-unit tag prefixes (e.g. engine/vX, operator/vX) or Changesets-driven versioning are required.

CROSS-MODULE VERSION COUPLING: operator bakes the dashboard image + engine version via `go list -m github.com/trianalab/pacto/v2`. Under a monorepo `replace => ../pacto` (or same-repo module) this returns empty, so DASHBOARD_IMAGE/pacto_version silently break — flagged high risk on the controller image + chart rows.

COORDINATE INCONSISTENCIES to normalize: pacto-dashboard IMAGE tags have NO 'v' prefix (2.7.0) but the pactos/pacto-dashboard BUNDLE tags DO (v2.7.0). Cosign format differs by repo: engine dashboard image uses default/OCI-1.1 referrers signatures (no .sig tags in GHCR), operator image+chart use legacy .sig format for Artifact Hub. Signing coverage is uneven: operator controller image + helm chart signed; engine binaries, engine dashboard image bundle-format signatures, pacto contract bundle, docs/demo all effectively unsigned/no provenance/no SBOM attestation (SBOM exists only INSIDE the pacto bundle).

MULTI-TRIGGER (not a cross-workflow duplicate, but fragile): pacto.yml publish job fires on either `release: published` or `workflow_run['Auto release'] completed`; docs.yml similarly fans in push + workflow_run + release. Both are single-workflow, if-guarded, so not duplicate publishers — but they depend on the literal workflow NAME 'Auto release', which must be preserved or rewired in the monorepo.

OUT OF SCOPE / not workflow-published: ghcr.io/trianalab org has pacto-demo/* packages (api-gateway, orders-service, etc.) — grep of all workflows shows NO workflow pushes them; they are manually/locally seeded demo bundles. CI-only byproducts NOT counted as release artifacts: Codecov coverage upload (ci.yml, cover.out/coverage.out), SARIF to Security tab + short-retention SARIF/digest/rebuilt-ui/pacto-dashboard-bundle upload-artifact (security.yml, ui-rebuild*.yml, pacto.yml) — intra-pipeline handoffs, not distributed artifacts. security.yml builds `local/scan:sha` but does NOT push it. ui-rebuild-commit.yml pushes a git commit to Dependabot PR branches (not a release artifact). No goreleaser config exists in either repo; all release logic is hand-rolled in auto-release.yml + release.yml (engine) and auto-release.yml (operator)."
